assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: ONE separate static 2D game prop on true transparent RGBA background.
Primary request: faithfully redraw and isolate the three-candle tabletop candelabrum from Asmodeus's bedroom in Helluva Boss S2 E6 Oops, shown in the supplied production background references. This is ordinary room furniture, presented as a neutral game asset.
Input images: Image 1 is a precise crop showing the entire candelabrum and its pedestal foot; use it as the governing shape/color reference. Image 2 is the complete production background for placement and scale. Image 3 is another official production angle showing the same object in brighter light; use only to clarify its physical construction, do not change the chosen dark pink lighting.
Subject details: exactly THREE slender unlit lavender-purple wax candles with their tiny black wicks; center candle highest, left intermediate, right lower. Three small oval candle cups on a single dark rose-bronze sculpted stand; left arm rises in a smooth outward curve, right arm curls downward and up. A tapered faceted central ornament, then a thin vertical lower stem and the small faceted pedestal foot exactly as visible in image 1. Preserve the original shallow three-quarter view, dark outlines, angular highlights, violet and rose shading. Keep all three wicks, both arms and the entire pedestal foot visible and connected.
Composition/framing: one centered complete object with generous transparent margin on all sides, portrait orientation. Preserve its real silhouette and proportions. It must stand upright without a scene.
Style: clean 2D animation cel shading and sharp linework matching the supplied reference, restrained flat shadows, no new ornamental detail.
Constraints: no table, mirror, wall, bottle, teapot, other furniture, characters, writing, logo or watermark. No added candles, flames, smoke, glow, floor, ground shadow, vignette, checkerboard or opaque backdrop. The empty area and spaces between the arms must be genuinely transparent.

assets.name: Asmodeus — console de la chambre
assets.canonicalContext: Console de la chambre d’Asmodeus dans Oops S2E6.
assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: ONE complete separate static 2D game furniture prop on a truly transparent background.
Primary request: faithfully redraw only the blue-purple rococo dressing console table from Asmodeus's bedroom in Helluva Boss S2 E6 Oops. Use the supplied production art. Empty table only; it is an ordinary piece of room furniture.
Input images: Image 1 (206 Paint 00007) governs the complete silhouette, all visible curled feet and the high three-quarter perspective: the table is on the right of the room, its left side recedes and its right side is nearest the viewer. Image 2 (206 Paint 00003) clarifies the three drawers and carved trim. Preserve the shape from image 1 instead of inventing another viewpoint.
Subject: the complete dark ultramarine-purple console with a sinuous scalloped top, recessed curved middle, gold/rose edge trim, two wide end drawers with curved handles, small central drawer with one round knob, stylized pointed corner trim, and the original thin rose-gold cabriole legs ending in curled toes. Keep the exact three clearly visible leg silhouettes of the reference; do not expose or invent a fourth hidden leg. The rear and far side remain occluded naturally by the same table body. Preserve the deep violet shadows and magenta edge highlights from image 1.
Composition: one centered complete table, native aspect proportions, generous transparent margin on every side. Entire tabletop, drawers and all visible feet fit inside the frame.
Style: clean sharp dark outlines, flat animation colors, restrained cel-shaded planar highlights matching the production background.
Constraints: remove the separate wall-mounted mirror completely; remove every tabletop object including candelabrum, coffee pot and bottles. No person, bed, wardrobe, mirror, wall, floor, shadow, glow, text, logo, watermark, checkerboard or background. Transparent space beneath the table and between the legs. Do not add a stool, extra furniture, ornate carving or new decorations.

assets.name: Asmodeus — Chambre, Oops
assets.canonicalContext: Chambre d’Asmodeus dans Oops S2E6, distincte du cabaret et de la rue Ozzie’s déjà livrés.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE opaque static 2D game environment background, landscape, approximately the same 1.63:1 framing as the supplied production painting.
Primary request: redraw this exact view of Asmodeus's bedroom from Helluva Boss S2 E6 Oops as a clean separate game background. Preserve the camera, architecture, palette and composition of the reference. The reference is a complete production background view, not a suggestion to invent another room.
Input image 1: governing production background 206 Paint 00007 by Jasper Luu, with the round bed at left and dressing console at right.
Change only these elements: remove the entire blue-purple console table at the right, and remove all loose objects that stood on it: the three-candle candelabrum, pot and bottles. Those are separate game props. Continue the existing plain deep-blue floor and the same existing heart-patterned lower wall behind their former silhouette. Keep the wall-mounted oval flame-shaped mirror in its original location and crop; it is part of this background.
Preserve: the large round magenta bed and its stepped circular platform dominating the left; its pillows, heart-patterned upholstery, stringy sheer canopy and illuminated platform bulbs; cyan stylized fireplace fire behind the bed; the dark blue double wardrobe doors and their original curved gold handles at back-right; deep blue draped walls, heart-patterned wall border, rose trim, dark blue floor, same foreground step edge. Do not widen, rotate or symmetrize this asymmetric room. Preserve the view's existing crops at the edges instead of imagining unseen furniture or room extensions.
Style/medium: crisp 2D animation cel-shaded background, clean dark lines, rich ultramarine, magenta, violet and pink with the same restrained ambient light. Opaque artwork to every canvas edge.
Constraints: no characters, silhouettes, extra furnishings, additional doors, candles or props, writing, logos, signature, watermark, UI, frames, panels or collage. No replacement console. This is one single static background, no animation.

assets.name: Blitzø — Noël imaginé
assets.canonicalContext: Vision/rêve de famille imaginé par Blitzø dans Sinsmas S2E12 ; ne désigne pas un domicile réel établi, le salon humain réel ou le balcon de Blitzø.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE opaque static 2D narrative game background, landscape, same framing and aspect as the supplied production painting.
Primary request: faithfully redraw this exact fireplace view from the family Christmas vision imagined by Blitzø in Helluva Boss S2 E12 Sinsmas. This is the imagined family scene, not a real new home or the ordinary human family's room. Use this provided production painting as the geometry and color authority.
Input image 1: Jasper Luu production painting 212_00005, governing every room detail.
Change only one object: remove the small glass snow globe containing a Christmas tree from the mantel, between the right-hand blue picture frame and the taller red picture frame. Leave its narrow place on the shelf empty. That one snow globe will be a separate prop. Keep the other snow globe with the tiny house at the far left of the mantel unchanged.
Preserve the centered brick fireplace and simple stacked logs, warm orange firelight, orange walls and polished floorboards; four dark-red stockings with pale cuffs reading exactly S, V, B, L from left to right; the gifts/stuffing already visible inside them and the patterned hanging scarf; the original four framed silhouette pictures and small horse ornament on the mantel; the horned little house and purple candle at its right. Keep the purple armchair at left, red armchair at right, their colored cushions, tree edge, foreground gifts, floor pillows, cookie plate and red cup at lower left, and the tiny partially hidden festive Blitzø toy at lower right. Keep the warm string lights and the room's existing edge crops and perspective. Do not invent the unseen backs or sides of anything. Preserve the small photograph silhouettes as simple indistinct artwork.
Text: only the existing four stocking initials S V B L. No new writing or labels.
Style/medium: clean detailed 2D animation background matching the supplied art, flat layered colors and soft restrained ambient warm lighting, crisp expressive outlines. Fill the whole canvas opaquely.
Constraints: no living people, new characters, scene action, extra furniture, extra stockings, extra room wings, new windows, watermark, logo, caption, border, UI, collage or panels. One single still background, no animation.

assets.name: Noël imaginé de Blitzø — boule à neige au sapin
assets.canonicalContext: Petit objet de la cheminée dans la vision familiale de Blitzø, Sinsmas S2E12.
assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: ONE isolated static 2D game prop, true transparent background.
Primary request: faithfully redraw and isolate the small Christmas-tree snow globe from the mantel in Blitzø's imagined family Christmas scene, Helluva Boss S2 E12 Sinsmas.
Input images: Image 1 is a precise crop of the whole small globe from production painting 212_00005 by Jasper Luu; it governs the object. Image 2 is the complete source painting for context only. Select the globe with the evergreen tree between the two right-hand photograph frames, not the other globe containing a house.
Subject: exactly one near-spherical warm pale-amber glass globe on its small low dark burgundy-red pedestal, with the simple stylized dark green tiered Christmas tree centered inside, tiny red decorations and restrained warm highlights. Preserve the simple dark-red base silhouette visible just above the mantel. Retain the large pale oval reflected highlight at upper left and the few smaller soft dots/reflections visible in the original. Use the same slightly elevated, nearly frontal viewpoint and proportions. Preserve the tree silhouette and do not invent new decorations or a different pedestal.
Composition: one complete centered snow globe, all of the glass dome and complete bottom edge of the base visible, ample transparent padding on every side. The globe's internal warm glass tint belongs to the object, not to the surrounding canvas.
Style: clean 2D animated-show cel artwork, precise simple dark outlines and a few flat/translucent highlights matching the reference; no photorealism, no 3D render.
Constraints: only one object. Remove the mantel, picture frames, room, other snow globe, characters and all surrounding material. No writing, labels, letters, logo, watermark, extra snow flurry, outer glow, cast shadow, floor, checkerboard or opaque background. All space outside the object must have true RGBA transparency.

Les minuscules décorations rouges au pied du sapin et les reflets sont interprétés à partir d’un crop de 120×105 pixels ; leur nombre et leur géométrie ne sont pas certifiés 1:1.

verification.sourceInspection: Primary production paintings and official public episode previews visually inspected before generation.

fidelityLimits: Nouvelles vues distinctes des 43 stages de la baseline V9 ; absence vérifiée dans runtime et catalogue avant sélection.
Les images conservent les découpes de cadrage de leurs planches, sans prétendre montrer un lieu complet à 360 degrés.
Mobiliers et détails fins sont redessinés ; comparaison artistique humaine requise, aucune certification pixel-à-pixel avec les sources.
Les scènes de rêve canoniques restent identifiées comme visions, sans déclarer de nouveaux faits narratifs réels.
